source_tier: trade press, multiple independent + GEM wiki
source_notes: FSU 'Bilbao Knutsen' (2004-built LNG carrier, 138,000 m3, converted to floating storage unit by HD Hyundai Marine Solution) arrived at Puerto Cortés in September 2025 to serve as the storage backbone for this terminal. Corroborated by LNG Prime (24 Sep 2025), WFW press release, Riviera, Splash247, and the GEM wiki page itself. ResearcherNotesProject (RR 10/25) flagged the vessel name/owner as undetermined — now resolved for the vessel name. Note this is an FSU (storage only), not a regas-equipped FSRU.

Centrica's 15-year SPA with Exodus (announced Nov 2025) is expected to commence in 2026, with ~6 LNG cargoes/year delivered ship-to-ship into the FSU at Puerto Cortés. Start year is implied from the supply-contract commencement, not a regulator-confirmed COD — hence yellow. No firm month available.
